overview.mechanism: Supplies iron required for erythropoiesis; elemental iron content, absorption and administration differ by iron complex and route.
uses: Treatment of iron deficiency, including appropriately assessed CKD-associated anemia; identify the actual salt or complex first.
overview.class: Iron preparation — formulation must be identified

paragraphs.text: The KDIGO 2026 anemia synopsis uses ferritin and transferrin saturation to guide iron therapy and prefers intravenous over oral iron in hemodialysis. It also emphasizes correction of treatable causes before erythropoiesis-stimulating therapy.

A registry heading of Iron does not identify an interchangeable medicine or define elemental iron content. Oral and intravenous preparations require their own product information; a universal dose for this heading would be misleading.

sources.citation: Evaluation and Management of Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease: Synopsis of the KDIGO 2026 Clinical Practice Guideline. PubMed PMID: 42735412.
